sql: SELECT ranking_system_id FROM ranking_criteria WHERE criteria_name = 'Award'
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM ranking_criteria WHERE ranking_system_id = 3
SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id GROUP BY T2.country_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.university_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_id IN (SELECT university_id FROM university_year GROUP BY university_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) >= 6) ORDER BY T1.pct_international_students DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T3.country_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id INNER JOIN country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id WHERE T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2016 AND T1.pct_international_students > 50
SELECT university_id FROM university_year ORDER BY student_staff_ratio DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT year FROM university_year ORDER BY num_students ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.system_name FROM ranking_criteria AS T1 INNER JOIN ranking_system AS T2 ON T1.ranking_system_id = T2.id WHERE T1.criteria_name = 'Quality of Education Rank'
SELECT T1.ranking_criteria_id FROM university_ranking_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Brown University' AND T1.year = 2014

SELECT T2.score, CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.university_id AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.university_id = 100 AND T1.year = 2015

SELECT DISTINCT T3.country_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id INNER JOIN country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id WHERE T1.year = 2013 AND T1.num_students * 100 > (SELECT AVG(num_students) FROM university_year) * 98
SELECT SUM(num_students) FROM university_year WHERE year = 2011
SELECT T2.university_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T1.year = 2011 ORDER BY T1.num_students DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.country_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T1.university_name = 'Harvard University'
SELECT COUNT(T2.id) FROM ranking_system AS T1 INNER JOIN ranking_criteria AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.ranking_system_id WHERE T1.system_name = 'Center for World University Rankings'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university_ranking_year AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.university_id AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.score = 90 AND T1.year = 2011

SELECT SUM(T1.num_students) - SUM(CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100) FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Harvard University' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012
SELECT id FROM ranking_system WHERE system_name = 'Center for World University Rankings'
SELECT T1.university_name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.country_id = T2.id WHERE T2.country_name = 'Denmark'

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students AS REAL) / T1.student_staff_ratio FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'University of Auckland' AND T1.year = 2015

SELECT CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100 FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id WHERE T2.university_name = 'Harvard University' AND T1.year = 2012
SELECT T2.system_name FROM ranking_criteria AS T1 INNER JOIN ranking_system AS T2 ON T1.ranking_system_id = T2.id WHERE T1.criteria_name = 'Quality of Education Rank'

SELECT T2.university_name, T3.country_name FROM university_year AS T1 INNER JOIN university AS T2 ON T1.university_id = T2.id INNER JOIN country AS T3 ON T2.country_id = T3.id WHERE T1.year = 2015 ORDER BY CAST(T1.num_students * T1.pct_international_students AS REAL) / 100 DESC LIMIT 1
